layout.arrangement: Minimal section-title slide: a thin red rectangular frame insets the whole slide; one large two-line red title is centered horizontally and sits slightly above vertical center; a solid black strip runs along the very bottom edge; a small mouse-cursor arrow artifact appears at the far-left edge at mid-height. No other content.

regions.name: Red border frame
regions.position: full slide; inset approx. 6% from left, 6% from right, 8% from top, extending down to ~96% (bottom edge meets the black bar)
regions.content: Thin dark-red rectangular outline, no fill; the light-gray background shows through inside it

regions.name: Title text block
regions.position: center (approx. 20%-80% width), vertically approx. 30%-70% of slide height
regions.content: Two lines of very large bold red text: line 1 '[3] Quick revision of' (centered at ~40% height), a blank-line gap, line 2 'Neural Netwok (NN)' (centered at ~64% height)

regions.name: Bottom black bar
regions.position: bottom, full width, approx. bottom 3-4% of slide height
regions.content: Solid black horizontal strip (appears to be a video-player control/progress bar captured with the slide)

regions.name: Mouse cursor artifact
regions.position: far left edge, at approx. 45% of slide height
regions.content: Small black arrow pointer with light outline, a screen-recording cursor, not original slide content

layout.hierarchy: The red two-line title utterly dominates (largest element by far, bold, saturated red on pale gray). Second in prominence is the thin red frame; the black bottom bar is low-profile; the cursor artifact is nearly negligible.

visual_elements.description: A single thin-stroke rectangular frame surrounding nearly the entire slide; stroke weight approx. 1.5-2 pt; no fill; corners are square; left/top/right edges clearly visible, bottom edge terminates at the black bottom bar
visual_elements.position: inset approx. 6% from left/right, 8% from top, down to ~96% height

visual_elements.description: Solid black horizontal strip across the entire bottom edge of the image, uniform height, no visible controls/text (video player bar)
visual_elements.position: bottom edge, full width, ~3-4% of slide height

visual_elements.description: Standard mouse-pointer arrow (black fill, thin light outline), tilted cursor shape, tiny relative to slide

imagery: No photographs, illustrations, charts, or decorative icons on the slide itself; only a screen-recorded mouse-cursor arrow at the left edge (recording artifact) and a black video-player bar at the bottom
typography_notes: Bold sans-serif throughout (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title is extremely large (approx. 54-60 pt equivalent), heavy weight, dark red, center-aligned, sentence case with a bracketed section number '[3]' prefix; no italics, no all-caps, no bullets. The two title lines are separated by an empty-line gap, giving an airy, spaced look. Note: the original slide contains the typo 'Netwok' (missing 'r' in 'Network') - preserve verbatim.
animation_state: Static slide; nothing appears mid-build. The full title is visible in its final state; no bullets or progressive reveal elements exist.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a blank slide and set the background fill to light warm gray #E9E9E7. 2. Draw a rectangle with No Fill and a solid dark-red #C00000 outline of ~1.75 pt weight; position it inset ~0.45 in from the left and right edges and ~0.55 in from the top, extending downward to just above the bottom strip (square corners). 3. Draw a solid black (#000000) rectangle spanning the full slide width at the very bottom, height ~0.25 in (this mimics the captured video-player bar; omit if recreating only the original slide design). 4. Insert a text box roughly centered horizontally (spanning ~20%-80% of slide width) with its vertical center at ~47% of slide height; set alignment to Center. 5. Type the title exactly as: '[3] Quick revision of', then insert an empty paragraph, then 'Neural Netwok (NN)' - keep the typo 'Netwok' verbatim for fidelity (optionally flag it to the slide owner for correction). 6. Format the text: Arial Bold (or equivalent sans-serif), ~54 pt, font color #C00000, single spacing with the blank line creating the gap between the two lines. 7. Do not add bullets, footers, slide numbers, or images - the original has none. 8. Optional (only to replicate the screen recording): place a small black mouse-cursor arrow icon with a thin white outline at the far-left edge, ~45% down the slide.
